sources.title: Object Concepts Emerge from Motion - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Understanding how object concepts are formed and represented in biological systems provides critical insights for building more robust and generalizable visual agents in artificial systems. However, what makes an object look like an object? This is a non-trivial question, as objects can vary drastically in appearance, shape, and motion patterns.

sources.title: Object Concepts Emerge from Motion | AI Research Paper Details
sources.snippet: The model employs self-attention mechanisms to group pixels with similar motion patterns. This creates object-centric representations that capture both spatial and temporal relationships between image regions. Efficient object representations emerge naturally through this process, showing how fundamental motion is to visual understanding.
